items.q: gee, was that owned by Dutch Schultz, Owney Madden or some people, and I don't know what they were in to.

ctx.x: And it was owned by ... I don't know what to call them ... I certainly can't call them hoodlums, because I don't know that they were, but they were gentlemen whom I would call today members of the organization or something, as they had sort of a rivalry with the Cotton Club, which was ... gee, was that owned by Dutch Schultz, Owney Madden or some people, and I don't know what they were in to. You know?
